name: CMUX Claude Exec
description: Launch a fresh cmux workspace, execute the bundled claude-exec recipe directly inside that terminal runtime under one composed Guardrail approval, and capture the resulting pane state. This recipe keeps the cmux host-runtime hop explicit while binding the inner Claude exec schema, trust, env, content-hash, and review_each_time semantics into the same approval unit.

socket_path.description: Absolute cmux socket path for the target terminal host

workspace_name.description: Human-readable workspace name to create for the launch

launch_cwd.description: Relative directory to use as the terminal workspace cwd before sending the inner Guardrail command

guardrail_repo.description: Relative path from launch_cwd to the Guardrail checkout that contains src/cli.js and the claude-exec recipe

prompt.description: Inline prompt text for the composed claude-exec layer. For a persistent named session (`lifecycle=continue|attach` with `no_session_persistence=false`), later user messages can change without reapproval as long as the composed session identity and executable boundary stay fixed.

input_files.description: One or more relative file paths resolved from working_dir for the composed claude-exec layer. Repeat --input input_files=... to pass multiple files.

model.description: Claude model for the composed exec layer

effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the composed exec layer

mode.description: Permission mode for the composed exec layer

output_format.description: Output format for the composed exec layer

max_budget_usd.description: Maximum dollar spend for the composed Claude invocation (e.g. '1.00')

system_prompt.description: System prompt for the composed claude-exec layer. This remains review_each_time.

working_dir.description: Relative working directory for the composed claude-exec layer

add_dirs.description: Additional relative directories to grant to the composed claude-exec layer

session_name.description: Session slot identifier for the composed claude-exec layer

no_session_persistence.description: Disable Claude session persistence in the composed exec layer

lifecycle.description: Session lifecycle for the composed exec layer

session_id.description: Machine-readable session identifier for the composed exec layer

capture_lines.description: How many trailing pane lines to capture after sending the inner command

capture_delay_ms.description: How long to wait before beginning pane polling after send

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll pane output while waiting for the hosted exec to finish

wait_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for the hosted exec to print its exit sentinel

steps.description: Create a cmux workspace, execute the composed claude-exec contract inside it, and capture the pane

constraints: This recipe keeps the cmux host-runtime hop explicit, but composes the bundled claude-exec recipe into the same Guardrail approval unit instead of launching a nested inner guardrail run
The wrapper creates a fresh workspace, executes a bounded composed contract, waits for a hosted exit sentinel, and captures pane output without shell-mode recipe steps

The composed claude-exec layer still owns its trust boundary, session contract behavior, env handshake, and Claude CLI auth/runtime requirements. `prompt` is interactive_message/session-bound; `system_prompt` remains review_each_time
socket_path is exact-match approved because it addresses a specific terminal control socket
One approval manifest covers both the explicit transport layer and the composed claude-exec layer; drift in either layer blocks reuse
invariants: Output is non-empty (validator enforces .+ on wrapper JSON output)
The hosted exec contract is always derived from the bundled claude-exec recipe
